title: Why do American homes often use wooden frames?

lines.text: Why are most homes across the United States built out of wood instead of brick or concrete?
lines.caps: Why are US *houses | built out of *wood?

lines.text: It is not because of cheap construction; it comes down to geography, efficiency, and engineering.
North America is home to vast sustainable forests, making structural lumber abundant and renewable.
lines.caps: America has *millions | of acres of fast-growing *pine

lines.text: Light-frame wood construction allows a crew to frame an entire house in just a few days.
lines.caps: A crew can frame a *house | in just a few *days!

lines.text: Wood also offers incredible thermal insulation and flexibility, making it far safer in earthquake zones.
Modifying walls to run modern plumbing, electrical wiring, and HVAC ducts is infinitely easier in wood.
lines.caps: Running *pipes and wires | is quick and *affordable

lines.text: Wood framing made spacious, affordable housing possible for millions of American families.
